title: LibScript Build Execution Plan
description: Deterministic, topologically sorted linear build execution plan generated by the constraint solver

plan_version.description: Semantic version of execution plan schema format

profile_name.description: Identifier of the originating profile configuration

target.description: Target architecture, libc, and operating system attributes

arch.description: Target CPU architecture (e.g. x86_64, aarch64, riscv64)

libc.description: Target standard C library runtime (e.g. glibc, musl, bsd-libc, nolibc)

os.description: Target operating system family (e.g. linux, freebsd, unikraft)

stages.description: Ordered sequence of execution stages to be processed linearly

items.description: A single logical build execution stage containing sequential tasks

stage.description: Identifier of the build phase or lifecycle stage (e.g. stage0-host-tools, stage1-cross-tools, stage2-target-sysroot, stage3-kernel-image)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this execution stage's purpose

tasks.description: Topologically ordered tasks to execute within this stage

items.description: Single task specification within a stage

name.description: Component or package identifier for this task

component.description: Relative filesystem path to component recipe directory (e.g. _lib/base-system/glibc)

action.description: Execution action to perform (e.g. compile, bootstrap, assemble, package)

stamp.description: Deterministic stamp filename used for tracking execution idempotency

items.description: Enabled feature variant name (e.g. wayland, pipewire, nls)

variants.description: List of active USE flag variants enabled for this task

env.description: Environment variable overrides injected into this task execution

license.description: SPDX license expression for this task component (e.g. GPL-2.0-only, MIT, Apache-2.0)

license_name.description: Human-readable name of the software license

license_file.description: Relative filesystem path to component's local license text document

is_bundled.description: Indicates whether component payload is physically bundled into installer distribution
